changelog: Aura AI v2.0.3 Voice Page Polish & WebGL Orb Integration
Part 7 3D WebGL Particle Orb: Interactive Three.js particle orb dynamically reacting to voice phases (idle, listening, thinking, speaking)
Bottom Controls Alignment: Centered 56dp 'Tap to Start' pill seamlessly aligned with 56dp circular Screen and Auto-on actions across all screen widths
Touch Feedback Fix: Eliminated all rectangular ripple boxes on round buttons and orb canvas with bounded circular shapes
Status Bar Contrast: Dynamic status bar insets ensure dark, legible clock, battery, and Wi-Fi icons on light landing backgrounds
Clean Edge Rendering: Eliminated stray WebView scrollbars and edge strips
